finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, `0 errors`, just the 8 expected deprecation warnings.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. [src/core/options.js](src/core/options.js) — bundler now sends `retryCount`, code still read `options.retries` and threw.
2. [src/net/retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — unset flags now come back `undefined` instead of `false`, so `isBackoffEnabled` threw. Treats `undefined` as `false` now.

The remaining warnings (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, punycode, etc.) are just noise from the dep bump, not blocking.
